content.short: CYBRO is a hub for liquidity providers, with vaults and tools for managing Uniswap-style LP positions.
content.description: CYBRO is a hub for DeFi liquidity providers, pairing yield vaults with a dashboard for tracking and managing LP positions. Users deposit into vaults and follow their performance, with a referral programme and a CYBRO token that can be staked for rewards and bridged across networks. Its site names Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Unichain among its supported chains, and Alchemy's Unichain directory lists it.
content.meta: CYBRO offers yield vaults and LP position management for liquidity providers on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Unichain.
